findings: Fixed pet quest maps item IDs to creature templates explicitly. Recall instead reads proto value1; discrepancies require reviewed conversion, never runtime resolution.
Fixed pet socket2 is a saved active marker; the live ECS actor is the authority. PetSystem validates item ownership and preserves recall intent after a transient spawn failure.
Fixed pet 34004/34009 bonus is dungeon-only. Other fixed-pet bonuses use source item applies. New explicit dungeon_only_bonus replaces these hard-coded checks.
Costume mounts are ITEM_COSTUME subtype2 in this build. Mounting hides followers and applies mount bonuses; dismounting resummons one follower.

Mount source also applies fixed +50 movement while riding. The offline converter must explicitly review this and any separately equipped/inventory bonus contribution; it cannot silently duplicate or drop either.
Real-time-first-use mount inventory fallback can infer seven days when both source duration and socket are zero. New catalog requires explicit duration, never an invented fallback.
Growth pets have independent persisted duration, level, evolution, bonuses, skills, feeding and eggs/transport. They are retained, not admitted by the fixed-companion implementation.
Legacy unique rides and pet/mount skins require separate reviewed behavior; they are not ordinary fixed seals by numeric category alone.
Companion prototype schema supports bonus-only configured refinement up to255. Ordinary smith recipes are refused until their writer carries companion lifetime/recall state.
Existing local database and game are unchanged. All listed source content remains unconverted until asset, policy, clock, bonus, reference and instance-state migration is complete.
